TZA.note: States nothing on AI harms rules.
The AI is in tax stamp enforcement, a sector system.

facts.fact: The Tanzania Revenue Authority says an AI system, adopted in November 2023 on its electronic tax stamp platform, notifies it when a stamp code is scanned in different locations, flagging duplicated codes.
The Tanzania Revenue Authority says inspections rose to 1 million scans in 2024 from 250,000 the year before and that detected fake stamps saved billions of shillings.

TZA.note: Platform by SICPA Tanzania; no local AI model, dataset or computing stated.
